## Summary

What changes and why. Link the issue if there is one.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (new rules need a test and a row in `docs/rules.md`)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated
- [ ] Docs and both READMEs updated if behavior changed
- [ ] No personal data, real secrets or local paths in the diff
